## Problem and resulting behavior
Explain the trigger, who is affected, and before/after behavior. Link the agreed task or decision.

## Scope and decisions
State relevant tradeoffs, non-goals and architecture decisions.

## Validation
List exact checks executed, environment, result and revision. Clearly state skipped checks and live acceptance gaps. Do not mark a planned check as passed.

## Risk and release
Describe security/privacy, dependencies, data/migrations, compatibility, deployment and recovery implications, or justify not applicable.

## Documentation
Update product contract, architecture/runbook and ledger as relevant.

- [ ] I reviewed the diff for secrets and sensitive information.
- [ ] Evidence supports the claimed behavior; remaining gaps are explicit.
- [ ] Applicable checks and documentation are complete, or blockers are recorded.
